plan.what: Validate the image path and set up global state
plan.fails_if: IMAGE_PATH env var missing or file does not exist

plan.what: Create a PDF containing a title, the image, and rendered markdown
Output a JSON object with the PDF base64 string
plan.fails_if: No output produced or JSON serialization fails

notes: Maturation rubric: Add a TITLE line above the image on the first page. Title uses Helvetica-Bold at size 24. Body text (if any) uses Helvetica at size 12. The image must still appear directly below the title on the same page. All other behavior identical to v1.
